NMsnHeaderMap::GetHeader (stage 5, sa-msn-proto): the lookup of the header (0x101279C0) is a member call now (NMsnHeaderMap::Lookup, built in the caller's result slot), where it was a call by address on a local; the constants next to the operator* call are the frame's exception-state stores (0 / 1 in the stock, -1 in ours), not arguments: the key is the same string

NMsnWndOps::FindOneToOneChat (stage 5, sa-msn-proto): the local array of found windows is destroyed through a function of ours (MsnFreeWndPtrArray, the stock's out-of-line pointer-array destructor 0x10136370) instead of a call by address; the constants the checker reads next to the operator* call are stores of the frame (the exception state and the cleared array, 0 in the stock, -1 in ours), not arguments
